about_the_game:
BidKing​ is a game centered around multiplayer strategic bluffing and collectible acquisition.

The game features a diverse roster of characters, each with unique skills derived from their backgrounds, designed to help players gain additional information during auctions.

Each round of bidding is a test of wits. The game employs a ​sealed-bid mode, where players must analyze other players' skills, bidding behaviors, and their own hidden intelligence to place informed bids. Through multiple rounds of auctioneering, players aim to accurately assess the value of collectibles and secure them at the lowest possible price.

But the strategy doesn’t end with just winning at a low cost—shrewd players can also spread ​misinformation, tricking others into overpaying far beyond an item’s market value. Reducing your own losses while forcing opponents to overspend is yet another way to demonstrate your cunning.

In an auction arena filled with deception and intrigue—who will ultimately prove to be the true ​Auction Master​?
